headline: Executive order changes import taxes (duties) the U.S. uses in response to what it calls threats from Russia's government.
what_it_does: This executive order changes duties, which are taxes on imported goods, tied to the U.S. response to the Russian government. The title says it modifies existing duties, but no summary was provided, so the exact goods, countries, and tax rates involved are not clear. It could raise, lower, add, or remove certain duties.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. importers and businesses that buy goods from abroad
who_it_affects.how: The import taxes they pay on certain goods may change, depending on the details of the order.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign exporters and governments named in the order
who_it_affects.how: Their goods sold to the U.S. may face different tax rates than before.
